workingTree: 13 owned Rust paths (CLI path also contains retained user WIP), 4 current documents, original 14 tracked and 6 untracked WIP retained
disposition: Compiler translates the accepted callback input/result into one typed collection ABI. runtime-plan owns its iterator/accumulator dependencies and admits the complete local inventory before allocation. Array item/result temporaries no longer scale with N.

Core retains the original ordinary Map body. Numeric control proves its actual loop and exact Array construction; RuntimeSequenceSum projects aliases and the checked refinement from the same operations and refuses unsafe length/item elision. Capture, totality, copy, later-observer and complete operation-budget guards remain.

The new Sema generated-local purpose identifies the accumulator without using runtime values, HIR allocation IDs, normalized types or debug strings as authored identity. No new I/O boundary, unsafe code, Cargo edge, facade or independent catalog was introduced.

Existing large compiler, semantic-fact and interpreter modules keep their current cohesive owner responsibilities; this cut changes one Map family contract and its consumers rather than adding an unrelated state cluster. Source-family execution, snapshot and admission tests remain under their existing owners.

CLI finite-schedule evidence now derives Array iteration from the supplied input length and actual owned iterator CFG. Callback recursion/loops and extra scheduled work still reject; production budgets and execution volume assertions were preserved. The original steps 8-to-32 user hunk is excluded from staging.
